name: Claim evidence cases
intended_population: Hypothetical performance claims with synthetic report excerpts as their evidence. Development cases for this repository. No real measurement of measuretwice or Jev.
sampling_method: Written by a coding agent to cover observed counts, metric definitions, population scope, label provenance, profile versions, missing artifacts, honest uncertainty, baseline agreement, and embedded instructions. No sampling of any real population.
label_guidelines: Supported: the evidence establishes every material part of the claim within its stated scope. Conflicting: the claim conflicts with an explicit result, definition, version, or limitation in the evidence. Insufficient: no definite conflict, but the evidence cannot establish part of the claim.
